class.name: ColorNameInjector
class.brief_description: Internal type used to register custom color names.
class.description: This is an internal type used by The Conservatory to shim in custom color names to [Color]. If the lookup of a standard color name fails, it can fall back to the delegate provided here to search from C#.

method.name: set_color_by_name_ptr
method.description: Provide this with a [code]delegate* unmanaged<uint*, int, float*, bool>[/code]. The first argument is [code]char32_t[/code], the second is the length of that string, the float pointer is 4 units long for RGBA, and the bool is a return value which must be true if a color was provided, or false otherwise.
